density: All pixel sizes are for a 3x screen (xxhdpi): 3 px = 1 dp.

slots.what: Seamless tile: warm parchment / aged paper. Very low contrast so text on top stays readable.
slots.where: Behind every screen in the Parchment (light) theme, under all text and cards. Fills the whole screen by repeating.
slots.look: Warm cream parchment (#F6ECD8) with faint paper fibres and very slight ageing. No stains, no borders, no vignette. Flat, evenly lit, no 3D depth. Contrast between lightest and darkest area under 8%.
slots.states: One picture only.

slots.what: Seamless tile: dark walnut wood grain. Low contrast; much darker than the artwork wood.
slots.where: Behind every screen in the Study (dark) theme.
slots.look: Very dark walnut (#1C120B to #2B1A10) with fine wood grain running horizontally; a hint of warmth, no knots or cracks. Flat, no highlights. Contrast between lightest and darkest under 10%.
slots.states: One picture only.

slots.what: Stretchable card frame: thin brass edge, leather or wood inside, rounded corners. Centre must be plain so text can sit on it.
slots.where: Behind each document card in the Library, and later behind other panels (voice cards, audiobook panels). Shown at any size from about 280 x 120 dp to full width; the corners stay about 20 dp.
slots.look: Rounded rectangle. Outer edge: thin antique brass line (about 4 px) with a soft highlight on the top-left and a darker edge on the bottom-right. Inside: oxblood leather (#6B2B24) with very faint stitching just inside the edge. Slight 3D bevel on the edge only; the middle is completely flat and plain so text is readable. Drop shadow is drawn by the app, not in the picture.
slots.text: None baked in. The app writes the title, author and buttons over it in cream or ink.
slots.states: Normal only. The app adds the pressed ripple.

slots.what: Stretchable button frame, normal state: brass edge, leather centre. No text, no icon.
slots.where: Behind the main buttons (for example Resume, Audiobook, Create audiobook) and selectable chips. Shown at 48 dp high and as wide as its text.
slots.look: Pill-like rounded shape. Antique brass rim (about 3 px) with a top-left highlight; inside, polished oxblood leather with a soft top-to-bottom gradient (lighter at the top). Gentle raised 3D look, as if the button stands slightly proud. Centre plain.
slots.text: None baked in. The app draws the label in cream (#F1E6D0) on top.
slots.states: This is the NORMAL state.

slots.what: Same shape as the normal button but pressed: slightly darker and inset.
slots.where: Same buttons as the normal frame, while a finger is pressing them.
slots.look: Identical shape and size to the normal frame, but pressed in: the leather a little darker, the brass rim dimmer, the highlight gone and a faint inner shadow along the top edge. It must line up exactly with the normal frame.
slots.states: This is the PRESSED state.

slots.what: Button frame, selected state (switched on / chosen).
slots.where: The same buttons and chips when they are switched on or chosen (for example the chosen pace, quality or theme option).
slots.look: Same shape and size as the normal frame, but lit: a brighter brass rim with a warm inner glow, the leather a little lighter and warmer, as if candlelight falls on it. Must line up exactly with the normal frame.
slots.text: None baked in. The app draws the label in cream (#F1E6D0) on top.
slots.states: This is the SELECTED state.

slots.what: Button frame, disabled state (cannot be used).
slots.where: The same buttons when they cannot be used right now (for example Start while another audiobook is being made).
slots.look: Same shape and size as the normal frame, but dull and flat: the brass rim grey-brown with no highlight, the leather desaturated and darker, no 3D lift. Must line up exactly with the normal frame.
slots.text: None baked in. The app draws the label in cream (#F1E6D0) on top.
slots.states: This is the DISABLED state.
